body:
## Pull request overview

This PR performs a comprehensive audit of the CRM example metadata to ensure strict compliance with `@objectstack/spec` types and adds full internationalization support across 10 languages. The work is divided into two main areas: fixing spec violations and implementing i18n infrastructure.

**Changes:**
- Fixed 3 critical spec compliance violations: corrected `variant: 'danger'` to `'destructive'` in 4 action files, converted `columns` from string to number type in 33 form sections across 10 view files, and added required `type: 'dashboard'` property to the dashboard schema
- Added comprehensive i18n infrastructure with 10 locale files (en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar) covering all CRM metadata including objects, fields, field options, navigation, actions, views, form sections, dashboard widgets, reports, and pages
- Implemented 24 automated tests validating both metadata spec conformance and i18n completeness across all locales

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 30 out of 30 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/crm/src/actions/account.actions.ts | Fixed action variant from 'danger' to 'destructive' |
| examples/crm/src/actions/event.actions.ts | Fixed action variant from 'danger' to 'destructive' |
| examples/crm/src/actions/opportunity.actions.ts | Fixed action variant from 'danger' to 'destructive' |
| examples/crm/src/actions/user.actions.ts | Fixed action variant from 'danger' to 'destructive' |
| examples/crm/src/views/*.view.ts | Converted form section columns from string to number type (10 files, 33 occurrences) |
| examples/crm/src/dashboards/crm.dashboard.ts | Added required type: 'dashboard' property |
| examples/crm/src/i18n/*.ts | New locale files for 10 languages with comprehensive translations |
| examples/crm/src/i18n/index.ts | Barrel file exporting all locales and types |
| examples/crm/src/index.ts | Added crmLocales export |
| examples/crm/src/__tests__/crm-metadata.test.ts | New comprehensive test suite with 24 tests for spec compliance and i18n completeness |
| examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts | Updated comment explaining strict: false configuration |
| ROADMAP.md | Added completion markers for spec compliance audit and i18n features |
</details>

According to the codebase guidelines (Rule #-1), ALL code comments and documentation MUST be written in English. The file header comments in non-English locale files should use English.

For example, this comment should be in English:
```typescript
/**
 * Chinese (zh) — CRM Example i18n locale
 */
```

This applies to all non-English locale files: zh.ts, ja.ts, ko.ts, de.ts, fr.ts, es.ts, pt.ts, ru.ts, and ar.ts. While the translation content (the actual strings in the locale object) should be in the target language, the code comments describing the file must be in English for consistency across the international codebase.
```suggestion
 * Chinese (zh) — CRM Example i18n locale
```
